newsitem.title: USA: JTS Corp says Q3 sales meet $30 mln target.
newsitem.headline: JTS Corp says Q3 sales meet $30 mln target.

text.p: JTS Corp, a maker of computer hard disk drives, said on Tuesday its third quarter sales have met the company's target of $30 million, and the company continues to expect fourth quarter sales will double that.
In the year ago quarter, the company generated $16 million in sales. JTS expects to report third quarter earnings "in approximately two weeks," it said in a statement.

In addition, JTS said it has completed a $15 million private placement of convertible preferred stock, giving it the financing it needs to meet production goals. JTS expects to raise money again late this year or early next year.

The new financing announced today calls for the company to issue non-voting, Series B convertible preferred stock. They convert into common stock at the current market price or at a discount and have an annual dividend rateof five percent.
If it is able to raise another sum around $15 million, JTS expects to ship over $100 million worth of computer hard disk drives in the fiscal quarter ending April 30, 1997.
In the third quarter, JTS said it shipped 221,000 units, up from 118,000 drives in the year ago quarter.

It is currently making 3.5-inch hard drives for desktop computers at a rate of up to 25,000 drives per week. It expects to reach weekly shipments of 40,000 units by the end of the calendar year and 50,000 units by the end of our fiscal year ending February 2, 1997.
